sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a levitating object (small permanent magnet
or superconductor puck) hovering above a base magnet or
current-carrying coil. Sliders: base magnetic force B₀ (or coil
current I) and object mass m. HUD: repulsive force F_rep(h)
(modeled as F₀/h²), weight P = mg, net vertical force. Student
adjusts sliders; simulation computes equilibrium height h* where
F_rep = P and animates the object floating there. Experiment: reach
target hover height by tuning I. Evaluate: hover animation hidden,
only equation-of-equilibrium shown symbolically; student solves for
I and submits. Wrinkle: the F₀/h² model is pedagogical — this is a
"how forces balance" exercise, not full Meissner-effect simulation.
